project_info.theme: Attractive event gift poster for launch activation attendees
project_info.color_palette: Soft Pink Gradient, White, Black, Rose Pink, Warm Gold

main_subject.detail: A pink event-gift poster combining Cocoon skincare mini products with a large pink fabric tote bag printed 'COCOON VIỆT NAM', highlighting check-in gifts worth 143K and game prizes worth 269K.
main_subject.style: Clean campaign giveaway poster, retail-event merchandising graphic, soft pink promotional layout

composition_elements.text: Visible text includes 'QUÀ TẶNG HẤP DẪN KHI THAM GIA SỰ KIỆN', 'Check-in nhận Quà tặng 143K', and 'Chơi game nhận Quà tặng 269K (Túi vải Cocoon & sản phẩm)'.
items: Top Left: Large white headline spanning the pink gradient top area.
Top Right: Pink gift icon circle floating near the tote bag strap.
Bottom Left: Black copy block 'Chơi game nhận Quà tặng 269K (Túi vải Cocoon & sản phẩm)' and a small cleanser tube in front.
Bottom Right: Large pink tote bag printed 'COCOON VIỆT NAM' dominating the composition.
Center/Background: Hau Giang lotus toner bottle, sunscreen tube, and a second gift icon near the text 'Check-in nhận Quà tặng 143K'.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Even product illumination, gentle gradient glow, clean event-promo readability

technical_specs.render_style: High fidelity retail event poster with realistic product packshots

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for event gifts at a skincare launch. Centerpiece is a large pink tote bag printed 'COCOON VIỆT NAM' alongside Cocoon Hau Giang lotus products and a sunscreen tube. Background is a soft pink gradient. Surrounding elements: headline 'QUÀ TẶNG HẤP DẪN KHI THAM GIA SỰ KIỆN', copy 'Check-in nhận Quà tặng 143K', copy 'Chơi game nhận Quà tặng 269K (Túi vải Cocoon & sản phẩm)', and two pink circular gift icons. Keep the clean promo hierarchy and exact tote-bag print. Technical style: high fidelity retail event poster with realistic product packshots, soft studio catalog lighting, even illumination and gentle gradient glow, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
